acip: GNYIS PA NI, TSUL KHRIMS DANG BRAL NA SBYIN 'BRAS NGAN 'GRO'I RTEN LA SMIN PA DANG, RTEN DE LA SNGAR GYI SBYIN PA'I 'BRAS BU LONGS SPYOD PA TZAM YIN GYI,
wylie: gnyis pa ni, tshul khrims dang bral na sbyin 'bras ngan 'gro'i rten la smin pa dang, rten de la sngar gyi sbyin pa'i 'bras bu longs spyod pa tsam yin gyi
english: Here next is our second point from above: how enjoying the fruits of these acts of giving in a succession of lifetimes depends upon continuing to follow an ethical way of life. If we fail to follow an ethical life, then the fruits of our giving will come back to us as we live in the body & mind of a being in the lower realms; and in this body & mind we will enjoy nothing more than the wealth which results from the giving we did in our former body & mind.
